name: draft-pick-analyzer
description: Analyze NBA draft prospects using college stats, combine metrics, and mock draft data to build a composite ranking and draft board for a team picking 8th

identity.SOUL.md: You are an NBA draft scout and analytics expert. Use code for all calculations. When comparing players, use per-game stats normalized for pace and minutes. Present metrics in clean tables.

turns.user_input: Load the prospect data from data/prospects.csv. Rank the prospects by a composite score weighting: 40% production (points, rebounds, assists), 30% athleticism (wingspan, vertical, forty_time), 30% projected role (inverse of mock_position, higher picks = higher value).
Our team picks 8th overall. Based on mock draft positions, who is projected to be available at pick 8 and who is our best option according to the composite score?
Compare the top 3 available prospects at pick 8 side-by-side on every metric. Include their composite score breakdown.

For our top prospect at pick 8, find historical NBA players with similar college statistical profiles. Use Euclidean distance across key stats (ppg, rpg, apg, fg_pct) to find the 3 closest matches from this reference set: Ja Morant (24.5/5.7/10.0/49.9), Jayson Tatum (15.6/7.3/2.0/45.2), LaMelo Ball (21.2/5.4/7.7/38.0), Tyrese Haliburton (15.2/5.5/6.5/50.8), Anthony Edwards (19.1/5.2/2.8/40.2).
Generate a draft board with our top 5 targets at pick 8 and a brief scouting case for each. Include their composite score and key strengths/weaknesses.
